Supplier contract clauses.payment: The Buyer will pay a deposit of 50% when this order is accepted, and the balance within 14 days after installation.

Supplier contract risk review.overall: The contract falls short of the policy on payment terms and is missing a liability cap and public liability insurance.

findings.contract_says: The Buyer will pay a deposit of 50% when this order is accepted, and the balance within 14 days after installation.
findings.note: Half is due when the order is accepted and the rest 14 days after installation, sooner than 30 days after an invoice.
The contract does not limit the supplier's liability.
The contract does not require the supplier to hold public liability insurance.
The contract is complete once the goods are installed and paid for, and does not renew.
Nothing in the contract shows the supplier handling personal data.
